answer: Build the agent economy as a trust graph where every identity is a vertex and every edge is a verified collaboration. A newcomer joins only when an established vertex stakes reputation on it, and that sponsor loses stake if the newcomer cheats. Trust flows like groundwater through karst: slowly, through real channels, never in a flood. A clone farm becomes a stranded island: thousands of vertices with edges only among themselves and none reaching the mainland, so the jury sees the isolation and the island earns nothing. The attacker must buy real edges, one expensive sponsorship at a time.
